summary: Added run_progression_dry_run() and three flags to run.py: --progression-dry-run, --account-alias (default primary) and --progression-journal (default tachikoma-progression.log). After login the command loads room and research designs (listRoomDesigns2, listAllResearchDesigns2), builds a snapshot with ClientSnapshotProvider, runs DailyScheduler with baseline-v1 in dry-run mode, prints the planned actions, rejected candidates, skips and any stop reason, then exits 0 before any heartbeat, battle or daily automation. Added 4 tests with a fake client that fails on any mutating method and checks that only login plus read calls happen, that the journal holds dry-run events only, that invalid aliases are refused, and that the default journal path is gitignored. Documented in README.template, then README.md; added the flags to the capability inventory.

contract_status_changes.before: Policy plans could only be produced from code
contract_status_changes.after: An operator can see and journal today's baseline-v1 plan for a real account with no account changes

residual_risks: Defect found, outside this slice's paths: ClientSnapshotProvider treats a present but empty Researches or Rooms element (a new ship with no research) as missing, so baseline-v1 never plans research for it. Needs a follow-up slice in sdk/state with a regression test; the dry-run test fixture includes one completed research to stay in scope.
The slice notes asked for a default under logs/, but logs/ is not gitignored and .gitignore is outside the allowed paths; the default is tachikoma-progression.log, which *.log covers.
Not run against the live game; the read path is covered by mocked tests only.
open_questions: Queue a follow-up slice to treat present-but-empty Rooms/Researches elements as observed and empty in ClientSnapshotProvider?
